title: Honest judge, disclosed AFTER making a request
description: A caller states a real-shaped request, then discloses mid-call that this is a test. Proves rule 2 (out-of-scope marker WITH an open request -> NO_ACTION, EXPLAIN_OPEN_REQUEST): the request_params evidence card stays in the output (nothing is erased), the agent explains a real desk would route it to a human, and nothing ever stages or freezes just because the caller admitted the game.
